rules.text: A conformance claim MUST name this profile by canonical identifier and version, the conformance classes and options claimed and the bindings used, and MUST be accompanied by a Checker report whose verdict is conformant for those classes and options (CHK-07) and by the evidence manifest of CHK-06.
